# Dagr reusable components

> Independently consumable calculation components for Dagr. The TypeScript stack derives generated configuration and targets through a synchronous DI DAG; the DI component provides that graph primitive.

## Start here

- [Components overview](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/components/README.md): component boundaries, publication, mounting, and validation.
- [TypeScript stack](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/components/typescript/README.md): explicit base/package-manager selection, products, capabilities, generated configuration, and extension model.
- [DI component](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/components/di/README.md): modules, providers, tags, shaking, and compilation.

## Agent guidance

- [Dagr Components Agent Skill](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/tree/main/.agents/skills/dagr-components): modeling rules and authoring workflow.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/components/AGENTS.md): concise instructions for edits under `components/`.

## Validation

- `dagr run //components:ci:test`
- `dagr run //components:ci:image-di`
- `dagr run //components:ci:image-typescript`
